---
title: "🏆 Playoffs are coming: get stickpicks ready"
---
The regular season ends in a couple of weeks. Playoff mode turns itself on when the NHL sets the first-round
matchups; this is everything that still needs a person.

- [ ] **Put Playoff Black on sale.** Run this once in the Supabase SQL editor (it only shows in the shop during
      countdown week and the playoffs anyway):
      `update shop_items set active = true where id = 'sweater_playoff';`
- [ ] **Check the bracket feed.** Once the matchups are set, open the home page: the Regular season | Playoffs switch
      should appear, and the bracket page should list all 8 first-round series. If not, run the "Update NHL games"
      workflow by hand (Actions → Update NHL games → Run workflow).
- [ ] **Plan the playoff push.** Bracket challenges are the most popular free sports game there is. Post in team
      subreddits, Discords and podcasts the week before the first puck drop (brackets lock then).
- [ ] **Watch the first Game 1.** Make sure playoff picks save and lock at puck drop.
